user_intent: Create and set up a new portfolio repository from scratch.
resolution: Scaffolded a Next.js 15 + TypeScript + Tailwind portfolio manually (Node was not installed, so files were written by hand), then installed Node LTS via nvm, installed the gh CLI from a GitHub release zip into ~/.local/bin, verified the production build, and made the initial commit. Site content was centralized in src/lib/site.ts.
